title: Digital Infrastructure and Development
summary: I am interested in how improvements in digital connectivity and other forms of infrastructure shape local economic development, particularly when the benefits of new infrastructure are distributed unevenly across space.

title: Spatial Development and Inequality
summary: I study spatial differences in access to infrastructure and economic opportunities, and how these differences contribute to uneven patterns of local and regional development.

title: Remote Sensing and Economic Measurement
summary: I am interested in combining conventional economic data with satellite imagery, geospatial information, and other nontraditional data sources to measure economic activity where standard administrative or survey data are limited.

title: African Development
summary: My regional interests center on African economies, with particular attention to infrastructure, technological change, local development, and spatial inequality.
